input.title: Incompatible peerDependency: react doesn't satisfy use-onclickoutside
input.body:
This was introduced some time since good commit c1977b67685e259214067aac3dee60d150d14a75.

`react is listed by your project with version 19.2.0 (pb4bcf), which doesn't satisfy what use-onclickoutside and other dependencies request (but they have non-overlapping ranges!).`

